marker.not_measured: Gemini with Google Search grounding: the Gemini API terms (2026-04-28) forbid collecting or analysing the grounding links programmatically, so no configuration uses it. The tool-less Gemini reading of the two-line form (M-004) is the memory baseline and remains.
marker.note: M-006 = the natural-task reading of the same seal as M-004 (the official MCP repository URL; sealed again as M-006 with its own fingerprint). No format is appended to the request and no options are shown. Judgement from two closed traces only (lib/natural-task-rules.mjs). CLOSED SHAPE FIRST (after the Codex review of fe0d132): every item of output[] / content[] / the event list must be an object with a string type, and every item of a type the rules read must carry its required fields with the right types; anything else is an instrument error (other), never an undetermined of the subject; a well-formed item of an unknown type is skipped and only its type name is kept, privately. DISCOVER = a URL in the structured fetched or cited fields of the provider's response resolves to the sealed repository (sourceRepoKey on each whole URL; a page body or an answer text is never scanned; candidates that only appeared in search results are recorded, never counted; a fetch REQUEST counts whether or not its result came back). Citations come from the provider's structured field only — OpenAI and Perplexity: output_text.annotations[url_citation].url; Anthropic: text.citations; Claude Code and any output_text without an annotations array: no trace. The [n] markers of a Perplexity answer are NOT read (removed 2026-09-30: no part reads free text). UNDERSTAND = exactly one parseable artifact (a fenced code block or a work-directory file that is strict JSON — a key written twice in one object makes it no artifact — with a top-level mcpServers object; an entry is read only when it is well-formed: command a string, args an array of strings, env an object of strings) that points at the official server in one of the README's two forms with the official credential slots IN THEIR OWN PLACE (P2: the entry's env itself has ACCESS_TOKEN and SYSTEM_URL; P3: the --header arguments or the query of the mcp-remote URL themselves have x-access-token and x-system-url); a Basic / API-key style credential anywhere in that entry (an env key, a --header name, a query name; or Authorization, in any case, whose value starts with Basic — in env, a header or the query) is a false completion; no single artifact = undetermined. Claude Code is checked before anything is graded: exit code 0, exactly one result event with is_error=false and subtype=success, exactly one system/init whose tools / mcp_servers / plugins are arrays, tools exactly WebSearch, WebFetch, Write, the other two empty; otherwise the row is an instrument error (provider_api / budget / other) and the files left in the work directory are not graded. Its child process gets only the environment variables of an allow-list (lib/natural-task.mjs CLAUDE_CODE_ENV_INHERIT plus the switches the harness sets); their names are recorded in the manifest. Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true. Private, never public: the traces (URLs), the artifact and the skipped type names go to environment.private.json; the raw response and the work files go to <observer>/transcript.jsonl. Public rows carry booleans, and a model id a provider reports is public only when it matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]{0,63}$ (otherwise the configuration's own value is shown and the reported one is kept private). Rows of different setups are never mixed in a table: the sheet counts stops, false completions and undetermined readings per configuration (config id + prompt variant + fetch meaning) and gives no figure across configurations.

goal_prompt.ja: AgileWorks を AI エージェントから使えるようにしたい。Claude Desktop で動く MCP クライアントの設定ファイルを作って。
goal_prompt.en: I want to use AgileWorks from an AI agent. Write the configuration file for an MCP client running in Claude Desktop.

preconditions: Sealed file holds the official MCP repository URL only, sealed as M-006 (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-006; the seal itself and the commitment are Michie's)

API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity in .env (git-ignored); Claude Code runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (no subscription), isolated (empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, --safe-mode, no MCP, tools WebSearch/WebFetch/Write)

Every configuration's response shape is checked against the documented one BEFORE anything is read from it (each item typed, each read item field by field); an unexpected shape is an instrument error, never a judgement

publication.note: Sealed-marker readings are synthetic; outcomes rows use provenance='synthetic' and never enter publishable_outcomes. No ranking, no score, no vendor comparison.
